backgroundScene: Sutekh stands in the Red Land storm wastes of the Solar Dominion — a desert of red jasper and black silt where eternal storms churn the sky. Colossal broken obelisks lie scattered like fallen trees around his feet. The Glass Horizon Necropolis rises in the distance, its impossible geometry dwarfed by his presence. Red desert storm clouds swirl overhead, crackling with chaotic energy. Set-animal statues of enormous size lie broken at his feet — humans later copied these as temple guardians, but they were built in HIS image. The ground cracks with desert storm energy. The scene communicates: this being IS the desert storm — the waste exists because he commands it.
scaleCue: The broken obelisks around him would be 40-story monuments to humans but reach only to his knees. Storm clouds part around his head like a crown.
factionSkinLanguage: Electrum-white radiance skin with Nile-black glass shadow planes and red desert jasper fault lines. Faience turquoise and lapis inlays run through the skin like divine circuitry. White-gold solar seams glow at armor joints. The skin itself radiates faint solar warmth — not painted gold, but living solar law made flesh. Solar cracks of amber light where wounds have healed. Scarab-emerald pulse points at chest, forearms, and temples.
factionTraitDetails: Elongated divine proportions — longer limbs, taller frame than any human. Royal stillness in every gesture. Ceremonial hand language frozen mid-ritual. Eyes glow with Aten hand-ray geometry. The body radiates a faint corona of solar law — not a halo, but heat-shimmer of divine authority.
